Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Start a managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Shut down a managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Gracefully shuts down the specified managed server. In-flight work is completed before shutdown.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Force shut down a managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Forces an immediate shutdown of the specified managed server without waiting for in-flight work to complete.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Suspend a managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Suspends the specified managed server, transitioning it to ADMIN state where it only accepts administrative requests.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Resume a suspended managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Resumes the specified managed server from ADMIN state back to RUNNING state, re-enabling it to accept client requests.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Restart SSL on a managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Restarts the SSL listen sockets on the specified managed server, reloading SSL certificates and keys.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Shut down a server via lifecycle API

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Shuts down the specified server using the lifecycle management resource set.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Start a server via lifecycle API

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Starts the specified server using the lifecycle management resource set.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Suspend a server via lifecycle API

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Suspends the specified server using the lifecycle management resource set.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Resume a server via lifecycle API

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Resumes the specified server using the lifecycle management resource set.
